title: Two-band model simulation
action: Implement the isotropic two-band semiclassical model for a compensated semimetal using the complex resistivity formula (Eq. 1 in the paper's methods) and evaluate the longitudinal resistivity (or magnetoresistance) over a grid of magnetic fields B = 1, 2, 4, 8, 12 T and hole-to-electron density ratios p/n from 0.95 to 1.05 in steps ≤0.01. Use representative carrier densities (e.g., n = p = 1e18 cm⁻³) and a mobility ratio μ/μ' = 2. Save the results to step_01_two_band_results.csv.
description: Computed magnetoresistance resonance data from the two-band model.
output_schema: CSV with header: B, p_over_n, value. B: magnetic field (T), p_over_n: hole-to-electron density ratio (dimensionless), value: longitudinal resistivity rho_xx (Ω·cm) or magnetoresistance MR (dimensionless). Must include rows for B in {1,2,4,8,12} and p_over_n ranging 0.95 to 1.05 in steps ≤0.01, with p_over_n=1 included for each B.
